items.comments: Our stay at the caboose was perfect! Super clean and a nice area in Ballard. Parking was super simple each day and Jennifer and her family were kind and attentive! Thanks and hope we get to stay again!

This little caboose apartment is a great place to stay while in Seattle. Jennifer and David are perfect hosts and have made the caboose comfortable and homey. The neighborhood is quiet with mountains in the distance and restaurants and shops nearby. I look forward to a return visit to this inviting space.

Jennifer and her family were great hosts, very communicative and warm. We felt at home with our two small children. Jennifer even bought an iron for the space at our request! They live in a great neighborhood in Seattle, great  for walking around and close to many restaurants and other amenities.
